title: ceiba salmonea
intro: Ceiba salmonea, commonly known as Kapok, is a tropical tree species native to Central and South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, pain, and infections. The bioactive constituents of Kapok include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-diarrheal, anti-arthritic, and antioxidant properties. The leaves and seeds of the Kapok tree are used in herbal medicine, providing a natural remedy for digestive issues, skin conditions, and respiratory problems.
